Trace, implement and test: 面试题19. 正则表达式匹配

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    bool isMatch(string s, string p) {
        int m = s.size(), n = p.size();
        int f[m + 1][n + 1];
        memset(f, 0, sizeof f);
        function<bool(int, int)> dfs = [&](int i, int j) -> bool {
            if (j >= n) {
                return i == m;
            }
            if (f[i][j]) {
                return f[i][j] == 1;
            }
            int res = -1;
            if (j + 1 < n && p[j + 1] == '*') {
                if (dfs(i, j + 2) or (i < m and (s[i] == p[j] or p[j] == '.') and dfs(i + 1, j))) {
                    res = 1;
                }
            } else if (i < m and (s[i] == p[j] or p[j] == '.') and dfs(i + 1, j + 1)) {
                res = 1;
            }
            f[i][j] = res;
            return res == 1;
        };
        return dfs(0, 0);
    }
};
